what: Create an invite; read the link

actions.eval: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) { const l = document.querySelector('[data-layer=door]'); const m = l && /unmapped:\/\/join\?i=[A-Za-z0-9_\-]+&k=[A-Za-z0-9_\-]+/.exec([...l.querySelectorAll('input, textarea')].map(x => x.value).join('\n') + '\n' + l.innerText); if (m) { window.__invite = m[0]; return m[0].length; } await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } return 'no link' })()
(() => { const l = document.querySelector('[data-layer=door]'); const t = l.innerText; const at = t.indexOf('Invites'); return t.slice(at, at + 600) })()
